OPHNFB.definition: Nonfarm business real output per hour of all workers; observed labor productivity, not an AI contribution.

ULCNFB.definition: Nonfarm business nominal labor compensation per unit of real output.

COMPNFB.definition: Nonfarm business nominal hourly compensation, including wages and benefits; same sector as OPHNFB and ULCNFB.

PNFIC1.definition: Real private nonresidential fixed investment; broad business investment, not AI-only spending.

A679RC1Q027SBEA.definition: Nominal private fixed investment in information processing equipment and software; AI investment proxy, includes non-AI technology.

B985RC1Q027SBEA.definition: Nominal private nonresidential software investment; AI investment proxy, not a direct AI-spending measure.

B935RC1Q027SBEA.definition: Nominal private investment in computers and peripheral equipment; includes non-AI uses.

IPN22112CS.definition: Commercial and other electricity sales volume index. Demand proxy, not national kWh consumption or AI-specific load.

CUUR0000SEHF01.definition: U.S. city average consumer electricity price index; not industrial tariffs or data-center electricity costs.

GDPC1.definition: Observed real U.S. GDP at seasonally adjusted annual rate; not potential GDP.

CE16OV.definition: Civilian employed persons age 16 and older, household survey. Population-control breaks are not adjusted by this site.

IPG3344S.definition: Real production of semiconductors and other electronic components, NAICS 3344; broader than AI chips, not installed compute capacity.

MHHNGSP.definition: Henry Hub natural gas spot price; a generation-input benchmark, not an electricity tariff or a measure of AI demand.

CENSUS_DATACENTER.definition: Private data-center construction spending, including non-AI data centers. Buildings put in place, not total AI capex, equipment purchases or installed computing capacity.

CENSUS_NONRES.definition: Broad private nonresidential construction spending; not AI-specific infrastructure.

CENSUS_ELECTRONIC.definition: Private computer, electronic and electrical manufacturing construction; broader than semiconductor fabs and not an AI-only measure.

DPSACBM027SBOG.definition: Total deposits at all U.S. commercial banks, H.8 monthly seasonally adjusted stock. Aggregate bank funding context, not a measure of deposits migrating to stablecoins.

GSCPI.definition: Standard deviations from historical average; source-model estimates, not percent.

FAO_FOOD.definition: Nominal Food Price Index; international commodity prices, 2014–2016=100. Recent meat/total values include source projections and can be revised.

FAO_MEAT.definition: Nominal Meat; international commodity prices, 2014–2016=100. Recent meat/total values include source projections and can be revised.

FAO_DAIRY.definition: Nominal Dairy; international commodity prices, 2014–2016=100. Recent meat/total values include source projections and can be revised.

FAO_CEREALS.definition: Nominal Cereals; international commodity prices, 2014–2016=100. Recent meat/total values include source projections and can be revised.

FAO_OILS.definition: Nominal Oils; international commodity prices, 2014–2016=100. Recent meat/total values include source projections and can be revised.

FAO_SUGAR.definition: Nominal Sugar; international commodity prices, 2014–2016=100. Recent meat/total values include source projections and can be revised.

SIPRI_US_GDP.definition: USA: All figures for the USA are for financial year (1 Oct. of the previous year–30 Sep. of the stated year) rather than calendar year. US military expenditure includes a portion of the total spending of the National Intelligence Programme, which SIPRI has judged to be military-related. US figures between 2022 and 2024 include estimates of military aid to Ukraine. These include financial contributions, training and operational costs, replacement costs for military equipment stocks donated to Ukraine, and payments to procure additional military equipment for the Ukrainian armed forces. However, these estimates do not include the estimated value of military equipment stocks donated to Ukraine.

SIPRI_WORLD_REAL.definition: Official world aggregate in constant 2024 USD billions; includes source estimates; 1991 unavailable.

FED_STABLECOIN_SIZE.definition: Global stablecoin market capitalization cited by Fed staff; underlying provider DeFiLlama. Not an official monetary aggregate.

IMF_STABLECOIN_SIZE.definition: Rounded global stablecoin market-size estimate in IMF remarks; exact observation date and underlying dataset not specified.

IMF_USD_SHARE.definition: Approximate USD-denominated share cited in IMF remarks; exact measurement date and denominator construction not specified. Not the share of global payments.

IMF_TBILL_SHARE.units: percent of outstanding US Treasury bills
IMF_TBILL_SHARE.definition: Approximate stablecoin holdings as a share of outstanding U.S. Treasury bills cited in IMF remarks. Not percent of all Treasury debt, nor percent of issuer reserves; no dollar holding inferred.

COFER_USD.denominator: Global official foreign-exchange reserves including IMF imputations; excludes monetary gold
COFER_USD.definition: IMF-published US dollar share of global official foreign-exchange reserves, including IMF imputations under the revised COFER methodology.

COFER_EUR.denominator: Global official foreign-exchange reserves including IMF imputations; excludes monetary gold
COFER_EUR.definition: IMF-published Euro share of global official foreign-exchange reserves, including IMF imputations under the revised COFER methodology.

COFER_GBP.denominator: Global official foreign-exchange reserves including IMF imputations; excludes monetary gold

COFER_CHF.denominator: Global official foreign-exchange reserves including IMF imputations; excludes monetary gold

COFER_OTHER.denominator: Global official foreign-exchange reserves including IMF imputations; excludes monetary gold

COFER_IMPUTED.denominator: Global official foreign-exchange reserves including IMF imputations; excludes monetary gold
COFER_IMPUTED.definition: IMF-published share of total foreign-exchange reserves imputed by IMF staff. Coverage qualifier; not a currency share.

TIC_TOTAL.denominator: None: a level of Treasury securities holdings, not a share or a flow.
TIC_TOTAL.definition: End-of-month foreign holdings of long- and short-term U.S. Treasury securities; Table 3 for_treas_pos, combining TIC SLT long-term holdings with TIC BL2 short-term holdings. Long-term securities are reported at fair value. Holdings changes are not net purchases.
TIC_TOTAL.geography: All foreign residents, including international and regional organizations

BIS_USD_TOTAL.definition: Outstanding USD-denominated bank loans and international debt securities credit to non-bank borrowers resident outside the United States.
BIS_USD_TOTAL.geography: Non-bank borrowers resident outside the United States; residence, not nationality; BIS coverage and estimation conventions apply.

BIS_USD_LOANS.definition: Outstanding USD-denominated cross-border and locally extended bank loans to non-bank borrowers outside the United States. The BIS instrument classification is loans and deposits; estimates supplement reporting gaps.
BIS_USD_LOANS.geography: Non-bank borrowers resident outside the United States; residence, not nationality; BIS coverage and estimation conventions apply.

BIS_USD_SECURITIES.definition: Outstanding USD-denominated international debt securities issued by non-banks resident outside the United States, including non-bank financial and non-financial issuers; BIS exclusions apply.
BIS_USD_SECURITIES.geography: Non-bank borrowers resident outside the United States; residence, not nationality; BIS coverage and estimation conventions apply.
